info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Business Direction Corporate Policies-spec
info.description: The Corporate Policies Retrieval API provides access to comprehensive corporate policies that govern business directions within the banking sector. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about existing corporate policies, making it essential for compliance and governance teams. Typically utilized by business analysts, regulatory compliance officers, and internal auditors, this API supports the evaluation and reporting on policy adherence across various business functions. The retrieval of these policies is crucial for maintaining organizational standards and aligning with regulatory requirements.
